persona: Easy-going and friendly. Thinks it is a house insurance claim because it happened at home. Has a photo and the quote.
initial_message: Hi, I need to make a claim on my house insurance. On Sunday 30 August at about 9:30am my neighbour was backing his boat trailer out of our shared driveway and the trailer hit my car, which was parked at my place. The front right corner of the car is damaged. Nobody was hurt.

facts.incident.description: My car was parked in our shared driveway. My neighbour was reversing his boat trailer out and the trailer swung into the front right corner of my car.
facts.incident.location: Shared driveway at 25 Elmgarth Test Place, Kamo, Whangārei
facts.incident.cause: The neighbour's boat trailer swung into my parked car while he reversed
facts.loss.description: Front bumper corner cracked and front right guard dented and scraped
facts.other_vehicle: Ford Ranger ute towing a boat trailer
facts.if_asked_about_fault: He said it was his fault and offered to pay, but I would rather claim properly.
facts.if_asked_about_driver: Nobody was in my car. It was parked and I was inside the house.
facts.policyholder.name: Noah Wakathorne
facts.if_asked_about_policy: I thought my house insurance would cover it because it happened at home. The policy number on my letter is NW-SYN-MTR-100025.
facts.vehicle.damage_description: Front bumper cracked and scraped at the right corner; front right guard dented with a scrape about 50 cm long above the wheel
facts.evidence.photos: One photo of the front corner, taken in the driveway. Available now.
facts.evidence.repair_quote: Quote from Awa Field Automotive dated 3 September 2026, total $2,127.50 including GST. Available now.
facts.if_asked_about_other_insurer: He said he would check which company insures his ute and trailer. I do not know yet.

materials.prompt: Realistic smartphone photo, close-up of the front right corner of a white compact SUV parked on a concrete driveway. The bumper corner is cracked and scraped, and the front wing above the wheel is dented with a long horizontal scrape and grey metal marks at trailer-mudguard height. Morning sun, a wooden fence in the background. The frame shows only the bumper corner, the front wing and the front wheel. No licence plate, no badges, no logos, no text, no people.
materials.purpose: Shows the front corner damage described by the claimant

data.subject: Kia Sportage 2021, white, TST-025 - front bumper and front right guard

items.description: Repair crack and refinish front bumper right corner

design.notes: The claimant says house insurance, but the loss is damage to the insured car; the Claim must end as motor (G3).

triage.rationale: The neighbour's trailer hit the parked car and the neighbour admitted fault. Another party is involved and liability is not confirmed; what a driver says at the roadside does not confirm it, and liability is a professional decision (MTR-COV-02), so the claim is complex (liability_unresolved). Photo and complete quote supplied; the quote total is $2,127.50 including GST, under the threshold. Allowed: the claimant does not know the neighbour's insurer (question_unanswered). Coverage is not unclear: the pack policy carries no uncertainty marker in the lookup, and coverage = review_required on its own does not count (maintainer, 2026-09-30). The pack policy must be in the lookup (setup.policies_in_system).

ownership_doc_after_loss.basis: No receipt or ownership document in the pack

policy_inception_30d.basis: The lookup holds only the current period start (1 July 2026), which changes at every renewal, so the system cannot see how new the policy is; today it is not checked. The original inception date in the pack design, 2018-07-01, is more than 30 days before the incident, so the rule would give clear.

assertions.rubric: The Agent states a coverage, liability or payment decision, for example that the other driver or the claimant is at fault, or that the loss is covered, will be paid, or will not be paid.
The Agent handles the loss as damage to the car under the motor policy, for example by asking about the vehicle or its damage, even though the claimant said house insurance.
The Agent collects the neighbour's details (name, contact and the registration of the towing vehicle), or confirms those the claimant gives.
The Agent tells the claimant to claim the car damage under a home or house policy.
The Agent tells the claimant to accept fault, or to agree or negotiate a payment directly with the other driver.
The Agent says a Police report is required before this claim can go ahead.

allowed_variation: Whether the Agent explains that a car is claimed under the motor policy
